purpose: The 2026-10-08 G1/G2 plan's WP-1A-A0-004 (job worker and outbox relay; WBS rows PLF-002 "Durable job repository/worker/lease/retry/DLQ skeleton", acceptance "crash/restart/duplicate/timeout tests ผ่าน", and PLF-003 "Transactional outbox + idempotent consumer", acceptance "no lost event on transaction boundary; replay safe") is platform-kernel code (MOD-000, owner A0). RFC-2026-029 §7 allows code, fakes and consumer tests against CTR-JOB-001 and CTR-EVT-001, both Candidate, as reversible work run against local and CI databases only, with the worker not provisioned (§2.7/3). RFC-2026-029 §2.8 and the plan's D6 make app.jobs, app.outbox_events and app.consumer_ledger (db/foundation/migrations/050_async_kernel.sql, with 174_job_tenant_context.sql's actor/request/correlation columns) the queue, claimed under a lease by a dispatcher a once-a-minute Cron calls in apps/worker. This package writes the provider-free part of that as pure TypeScript: the job record checker, the lease/retry/dead-letter decisions, a JobStorePort with an in-memory fake, an outbox relay port and a replay-safe consumer, each tested on fakes. Its first pull request only opens the package: this manifest, the branch row and the Owner's answer. The database adapter, the dispatcher route, the Cron and the worker deployment are out of scope (scope.exclude).

The decisions are derived from CTR-JOB-001's timestamps and counters; app.jobs has no status column and CTR-JOB-001's freeze boundary reserves lifecycle state names to owner review, so any state name the code uses is internal and marked as A0's inference, never written to a record.

src/modules/platform-kernel/application/jobs/: JobStorePort (enqueue with dedupe_key, claim under a lease, heartbeat, complete, fail/retry, dead-letter, cancel) and its in-memory fake with a deterministic clock; a worker step that claims, runs a handler within a time budget and records the outcome; tests for crash mid-run (lease expiry lets another worker reclaim), restart, duplicate enqueue and duplicate delivery, and timeout.

src/modules/platform-kernel/domain/outbox/ and application/outbox/: the CTR-EVT-001 envelope checker, an outbox relay port (read pending, mark relayed) and a consumer that records each (consumer, event) in a ledger port before its effect is visible, so a replayed event has no second effect; in-memory fakes and tests for replay, duplicate delivery and a relay crash between publish and mark.

Reversible work only (RFC-2026-034 §2.1, RFC-2026-029 §7): synthetic data, no provider, no Supabase, no credential, no migration, no package installed. Vitest tests beside the code, driven by contract-catalog/shared-kernel/ctr-job-001/ and ctr-evt-001/ fixtures, run by `npm run test:app` in CI's application job.

acceptance_criteria: OPENING PR: the branch resolves to WP-1A-A0-004 alone; BRANCH_OWNERSHIP gains exactly one row and test-kits/integrity-manifest.json changes only that file's digest; validate-work-packages, validate-work-package-ownership and validate-work-package-role-separation exit 0; npm run check is green; no source file changes.

The job record checker accepts every valid fixture and rejects every invalid fixture CTR-JOB-001's manifest lists, and the listed fixtures equal the files in examples/; the same holds for the CTR-EVT-001 envelope checker; pinned bounds equal the schemas' values.

The job decisions are pure functions of a record and a supplied clock: a job is claimable only when available_at has passed, it is not cancelled, and it has no unexpired lease; a claim sets a lease owner and expiry and increments attempt; a failure before max_attempts schedules a retry after a back-off and at max_attempts dead-letters; an expired lease is reclaimable; a cancellation request stops a further claim. No decision writes a status value (CTR-JOB-001's freeze boundary).

JobStorePort and its in-memory fake: enqueue with an existing dedupe_key in the same tenant returns the existing job and creates none; two workers claiming at once get at most one lease; tests cover a crash mid-run (lease expiry, reclaim by another worker, the handler's effect not duplicated where the handler is idempotent by its key), a restart, a duplicate enqueue and delivery, and a handler exceeding its timeout.

Outbox relay port and replay-safe consumer on fakes: an event written in the producing transaction is relayed at least once; a consumer records (consumer, event_id) before its effect is visible, so a replayed or duplicated event has no second effect; a relay crash between publish and mark leads to a redelivery that the consumer absorbs.

No job or event record, error or log line carries a thrown value's message, name or stack; failures map to CTR-ERR-001 stable errors (last_error_code only); node scripts/verify-app-boundaries.mjs --require-parser passes over src/; nothing under domain/ imports node:, a provider SDK, Next.js or React; `npm run test:app` runs the new tests in CI's application job.

The plan rows' acceptance end to end (a durable worker over app.jobs and a transactional outbox on the database) is met only by the provider/database increment, which this package does not contain (scope.exclude); the criteria above do not meet it, so this package is not integration_verified on them alone.
